ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the document:  Automobile Corporation of Goa Limited's board approved its audited Q2/H1 FY2027 financial results and a significant share buyback of approximately 2.38% of its equity for ~INR 29 crores, from which promoters will not participate, thereby increasing their proportionate ownership. A material impact and red flag is the considerable year-over-year decline in half-year profits and Earnings Per Share, despite an increase in revenue, signaling potential margin pressures or increased operational costs.
